mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months compresses discount rates for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS has declined for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 9.0%, it signals a deteriorating labor market that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where UNRATE > 9.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A strong labor market (PAYEMS growth > 0.5% MoM) combined with moderate inflation (CPIAUCSL growth < 2.0% YoY) signals sustainable economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction between PAYEMS growth > 0.5% and CPIAUCSL growth < 2.0% fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime (defined by GDPC1 quarterly growth > 2.0% and HOUST > 500k), rising housing starts signal sustained economic momentum, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In the late-cycle expansion regime (GDPC1 growth > 2.0% and HOUST > 500k), rising HOUST fails to yield positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production over the past three months indicates robust manufacturing activity and corporate capacity utilization, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where INDPRO has increased for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year CPI growth exceeds 2.5%, it signals an inflationary threat that prompts the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where CPIAUCSL growth exceeds 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A strong consumer spending trend (RSAFS growth > 1.0% MoM) combined with robust labor market growth (PAYEMS growth > 0.3% MoM) signals rising disposable income and corporate revenue, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction between RSAFS growth > 1.0% and PAYEMS growth > 0.3% fails to produce positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in housing starts over the past three months indicates strong residential construction and consumer confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where HOUST has increased for three consecutive months.
